content:
Ted Lasso returns for its fourth season this week (watch here), and Apple has just announced a creative marketing campaign: a Ted lookalike contest will be held at Apple Fifth Avenue in New York City.

'Gathering of the Teds' will take over Apple Fifth Avenue this week, with three rounds of elimination.

Apple TV's most anticipated new series of the year is set to premiere this week.

Ted Lasso season 4 will premiere at 9 AM Hong Kong time on Wednesday (9 PM Eastern Time / 6 PM Pacific Time on Tuesday).

As long as you have a valid Apple TV subscription, you can watch Ted Lasso here.

To celebrate the show's return, Apple's marketing team came up with a special idea: a Ted lookalike contest will be held in New York City.

This Thursday, August 6, at 5 PM, Apple Fifth Avenue plaza will host the 'Gathering of the Teds'.

According to the official website gatheringoftheteds.com, the contest is divided into three rounds, with contestants being eliminated in each round:

Round 1 ('Ted Charm') will be scored based on contestants introducing themselves in character and performing a two-minute dance routine. ... Round 2 ('Head Coach') will be scored based on finalists' performance in a trivia game and their dedication to the Ted Lasso character. ... Round 3 ('Ted Talk') requires contestants to deliver a short inspirational speech to the crowd.

The full rules of the contest, including judging criteria for each round, are posted on the website.

Prizes: 'There are a total of four (4) prizes with a combined approximate retail value (ARV) of US$300, including a custom football scarf (3) for each finalist, and a pair of custom Beats headphones (1) for the winner.'

Do you want to participate in the Ted Lasso lookalike contest? Feel free to let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs US$12.99 per month, and you can also enjoy a discount through the Apple One bundle.
